status: 已有获批疫苗，产品和推荐人群因地区而异。
Licensed vaccines are available; products and eligibility vary by jurisdiction.
options: 包括更新株的mRNA及蛋白亚单位疫苗；主要目标是减少重症和死亡。
Options include updated mRNA and protein-subunit vaccines, primarily to reduce severe disease and death.
limits: 接种不保证完全阻断感染；既往感染、免疫状态和当地最新建议影响适用方案。
Vaccination does not guarantee prevention of infection; prior infection, immune status and current local guidance matter.

status: 高风险患者有已建立的早期抗病毒治疗。
Established early antiviral treatments are available for high-risk patients.
options: 奈玛特韦／利托那韦、瑞德西韦；莫努匹韦在部分地区作为不能使用优先方案时的替代。
Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir and remdesivir; molnupiravir is an alternative in some jurisdictions when preferred options cannot be used.
limits: 需评估药物相互作用、器官功能、妊娠及适应证；治疗急性感染不等于已证实可治疗所有长新冠。
Eligibility, interactions, organ function and pregnancy require assessment; acute treatment is not proof of benefit for every form of long COVID.

status: 季节性流感疫苗已广泛使用。
Seasonal influenza vaccines are widely available.
options: 灭活、重组和减毒活疫苗等类型，依当地年龄及健康状况选择。
Inactivated, recombinant and live-attenuated products are selected according to local eligibility.
limits: 通常需按流行季更新；株匹配与免疫状态影响保护，不能将季节性疫苗外推至所有动物源流感。
Seasonal updating is generally needed; match and immune status affect protection, which cannot be extrapolated to all zoonotic influenza.

status: 已有获批流感抗病毒药。
Licensed influenza antivirals are available.
options: 奥司他韦、扎那米韦、帕拉米韦和玛巴洛沙韦；是否适用取决于病情和人群。
Oseltamivir, zanamivir, peramivir and baloxavir; selection depends on illness and patient factors.
limits: 耐药、妊娠、年龄和基础疾病会影响选择；抗病毒药不能替代疫苗。
Resistance, pregnancy, age and underlying conditions affect selection; antivirals do not replace vaccination.

status: 已有成人及孕期适用疫苗；婴儿预防抗体不是疫苗。
Vaccines are available for eligible adults and pregnancy; infant preventive antibodies are not vaccines.
options: 成人产品包括Abrysvo、Arexvy和mResvia；孕期产品须按当地特定适应证。尼塞韦单抗、克莱索韦单抗用于符合条件婴儿的被动保护。
Adult products include Abrysvo, Arexvy and mResvia; maternal use is product-specific. Nirsevimab and clesrovimab provide passive protection for eligible infants.
limits: 各产品不可视为可互换的年龄／孕期适应证；预防产品不用于治疗已发生的RSV感染。
Products do not have interchangeable age or pregnancy indications; prevention products do not treat established RSV illness.

status: 普通RSV感染不常规推荐抗病毒药。
Antivirals are not routinely recommended for ordinary RSV illness.
options: 以补液、呼吸支持及并发症处理为主；利巴韦林仅涉及特定严重感染的专科情境。
Care focuses on hydration, respiratory support and complications; ribavirin belongs to selected severe-disease specialist contexts.
limits: 利巴韦林不是所有儿童的常规治疗；预防性单抗疗效不能直接作为治疗疗效。
Ribavirin is not routine treatment for all children; preventive antibody efficacy cannot be treated as therapeutic efficacy.

sources.title: CDC · Symptoms and care of RSV

status: 尚无获批HMPV疫苗。
No licensed HMPV vaccine is available.
options: 候选疫苗仍属研究；不能把RSV疫苗的适应证延伸为HMPV预防。
Vaccine candidates remain investigational; RSV vaccine indications do not extend to HMPV.
limits: 临床研究信号不等于获批或已证实的长期保护。
Clinical research signals do not establish licensure or durable protection.

status: 尚无获批HMPV特异性抗病毒药。
No HMPV-specific antiviral is approved.
options: 主要为对症、补液和必要的氧疗／住院支持。
Management is symptomatic, with hydration and oxygen or hospital support when needed.
limits: 体外活性或个案用药不足以支持常规处方；重症与免疫低下患者需专科评估。
Laboratory activity or case reports do not justify routine prescribing; severe and immunocompromised cases need specialist assessment.

status: 尚无鼻病毒疫苗。
No rhinovirus vaccine is available.
options: 预防依赖呼吸道卫生等措施；多型别覆盖仍是研究问题。
Prevention relies on respiratory hygiene and related measures; broad type coverage remains a research question.
limits: 其他呼吸道病毒疫苗不提供已建立的鼻病毒特异性保护。
Vaccines against other respiratory viruses do not provide established rhinovirus-specific protection.

status: 尚无特异性抗病毒治疗。
No specific antiviral treatment is established.
options: 通常支持治疗；若诱发哮喘或其他基础病加重，需要同时治疗该并发问题。
Care is usually supportive; triggered asthma or other disease exacerbations require separate management.
limits: 治疗哮喘加重不等于清除鼻病毒，抗菌药不能治疗单纯鼻病毒感染。
Treating an asthma exacerbation does not eradicate rhinovirus; antibiotics do not treat uncomplicated rhinovirus infection.

status: 有特定型别和人群的疫苗，并非公众通用疫苗。
A vaccine exists for specific types and populations, not for general public use.
options: 美国口服4型／7型活疫苗限符合条件的军人使用。
The US oral live type 4/7 vaccine is restricted to eligible military personnel.
limits: 不覆盖全部腺病毒型别；作为载体的腺病毒疫苗不等于腺病毒病疫苗。
It does not cover all adenovirus types; adenoviral-vector vaccines are not adenovirus-disease vaccines.

status: CDC指出没有FDA批准的腺病毒治疗抗病毒药。
CDC reports no FDA-approved antiviral for adenovirus treatment.
options: 轻症支持治疗；严重或移植相关感染需感染专科处理。
Mild illness receives supportive care; severe or transplant-associated infection requires specialist management.
limits: 非适应证用药或试验方案不能标记为常规获批治疗。
Off-label or trial regimens should not be labelled as routinely approved therapy.

status: 已有常规预防疫苗。
Routine preventive vaccines are available.
options: 常以麻疹／腮腺炎／风疹联合疫苗（MMR）提供保护。
Protection is commonly provided through combined measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccination.
limits: 减毒活疫苗的孕期与免疫低下禁忌需按当地指南核对；接种是预防而非治疗。
Pregnancy and immunocompromise restrictions for live vaccines follow local guidance; vaccination is preventive, not therapeutic.

status: 暂无常规特异性抗病毒治疗。
No routine specific antiviral treatment is established.
options: 对症和支持治疗，并及时处理器官并发症。
Management is symptomatic and supportive, with prompt care for organ complications.
limits: 维生素A可属于医师指导下的病例管理，但不是疫苗替代品或特异性抗病毒药。
Vitamin A may be part of clinician-directed case management, but is neither a vaccine substitute nor a specific antiviral.

status: 已有常规预防疫苗。
Routine preventive vaccines are available.
options: 常以麻疹／腮腺炎／风疹联合疫苗（MMR）提供保护。
Protection is commonly provided through combined measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccination.
limits: 减毒活疫苗的孕期与免疫低下禁忌需按当地指南核对；接种是预防而非治疗。
Pregnancy and immunocompromise restrictions for live vaccines follow local guidance; vaccination is preventive, not therapeutic.

status: 暂无常规特异性抗病毒治疗。
No routine specific antiviral treatment is established.
options: 对症和支持治疗，并及时处理器官并发症。
Management is symptomatic and supportive, with prompt care for organ complications.
limits: 接种后仍可发生感染，通常病情较轻；暴发应对需遵循公共卫生建议。
Breakthrough illness can occur and is often milder; outbreak responses follow public-health guidance.

status: 已有常规预防疫苗。
Routine preventive vaccines are available.
options: 常以麻疹／腮腺炎／风疹联合疫苗（MMR）提供保护。
Protection is commonly provided through combined measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccination.
limits: 减毒活疫苗的孕期与免疫低下禁忌需按当地指南核对；接种是预防而非治疗。
Pregnancy and immunocompromise restrictions for live vaccines follow local guidance; vaccination is preventive, not therapeutic.

status: 暂无常规特异性抗病毒治疗。
No routine specific antiviral treatment is established.
options: 对症和支持治疗，并及时处理器官并发症。
Management is symptomatic and supportive, with prompt care for organ complications.
limits: 孕期感染需专科评估；预防先天性风疹是疫苗的重要公共卫生目标。
Infection during pregnancy requires specialist assessment; preventing congenital rubella is a major vaccination goal.

status: 水痘和带状疱疹有不同的预防疫苗。
Varicella and shingles have distinct preventive vaccines.
options: 水痘疫苗用于预防初次感染；重组带状疱疹疫苗Shingrix用于符合条件者预防再激活疾病。
Varicella vaccine prevents primary disease; recombinant zoster vaccine Shingrix prevents shingles in eligible people.
limits: 两种用途不能互换；疫苗不治疗现有皮疹或清除已建立的潜伏感染。
The indications are not interchangeable; vaccination does not treat an active rash or clear established latency.

status: 已有临床使用的抗病毒药。
Established antivirals are used clinically.
options: 阿昔洛韦、伐昔洛韦；带状疱疹还可用泛昔洛韦，按临床情况选择。
Acyclovir and valacyclovir; famciclovir is also an option for shingles, selected according to clinical circumstances.
limits: 眼部、神经系统或播散病变需要紧急专科处理；抗病毒药不保证消除带状疱疹后神经痛。
Ocular, neurological or disseminated disease requires urgent specialist care; antivirals do not guarantee prevention of postherpetic neuralgia.

status: 尚无常规获批HSV预防疫苗。
No routinely licensed preventive HSV vaccine is available.
options: 预防性和治疗性疫苗仍属研究方向。
Preventive and therapeutic vaccines remain research areas.
limits: 不能把带状疱疹疫苗用于声称预防HSV感染。
Shingles vaccination should not be claimed to prevent HSV infection.

status: 抗病毒药可控制发作与复发，但不能根除潜伏病毒。
Antivirals control episodes and recurrence but do not eradicate latent virus.
options: 阿昔洛韦、伐昔洛韦、泛昔洛韦用于符合适应证的发作期或抑制治疗。
Acyclovir, valacyclovir and famciclovir are used for indicated episodic or suppressive treatment.
limits: 疗效目标是减少症状、复发和部分传播风险；新生儿、脑炎及眼部感染需专科处理。
Goals include fewer symptoms, recurrences and some transmission risk; neonatal, encephalitic and ocular disease need specialist care.

status: 目前无可用EBV疫苗。
No EBV vaccine is currently available.
options: 疫苗临床研究不等于已批准的日常预防措施。
Clinical vaccine research is not an approved routine preventive measure.
limits: 预防感染、传染性单核细胞增多症与远期肿瘤是不同的疗效终点。
Prevention of infection, mononucleosis and later malignancy are distinct efficacy endpoints.

status: 普通EBV／单核细胞增多症无已建立的特异治疗。
There is no established specific treatment for ordinary EBV infection or mononucleosis.
options: 以休息、补液及症状管理为主；EBV相关肿瘤或移植后淋巴增殖性疾病需另行专科治疗。
Care emphasizes rest, hydration and symptom management; EBV-associated cancers or post-transplant lymphoproliferative disease require separate specialist treatment.
limits: 肿瘤治疗或细胞治疗适应证不能外推为所有EBV携带者的抗病毒疗法。
Cancer or cellular-therapy indications cannot be extrapolated to antiviral treatment for all EBV carriers.

status: 尚无常规获批CMV疫苗。
No routinely licensed CMV vaccine is available.
options: 疫苗仍在研究，预防先天感染和移植相关疾病的目标需分开评估。
Vaccines remain investigational; congenital-infection and transplant-disease endpoints require separate evaluation.
limits: 抗病毒预防不等于疫苗免疫，健康成人无症状感染通常不需治疗。
Antiviral prophylaxis is not vaccination; asymptomatic healthy adults usually do not need treatment.

status: 特定CMV器官病和移植情境有抗病毒治疗。
Antivirals are available for specified CMV organ disease and transplant settings.
options: 更昔洛韦／缬更昔洛韦常用于CMV疾病；膦甲酸或西多福韦用于特定替代情境；马立巴韦获批用于特定移植后难治性CMV。
Ganciclovir/valganciclovir are used for CMV disease; foscarnet or cidofovir in selected alternative settings; maribavir is approved for specified refractory post-transplant CMV.
limits: 须区分预防和治疗，监测骨髓／肾毒性及耐药；先天性CMV有独立适应证与证据边界。
Prophylaxis and treatment differ; marrow/renal toxicity and resistance matter. Congenital CMV has separate eligibility and evidence limits.

status: 已有多价预防性HPV疫苗。
Multivalent preventive HPV vaccines are available.
options: 包括二价、四价、九价产品；当地供应和适应证不同，九价疫苗用于覆盖更多相关型别。
Products include bivalent, quadrivalent and nonavalent vaccines; local availability and indications differ. Nine-valent products cover additional types.
limits: 用于预防新感染及相关癌症，不用于清除既有感染；接种后仍需按建议筛查。
They prevent new infections and associated cancers, not established infection; recommended screening remains necessary.

status: 暂无用于清除HPV本身的常规抗病毒疗法。
No routine antiviral clears HPV itself.
options: 治疗针对疣、癌前病变或肿瘤，可包括局部治疗、手术及肿瘤综合治疗。
Treatment targets warts, precancer or cancer, using local interventions, surgery or oncological care as appropriate.
limits: 病变消失不证明病毒完全清除；治疗性疫苗不能与已上市预防疫苗混为一谈。
Lesion resolution does not prove viral eradication; therapeutic vaccine candidates differ from licensed preventive vaccines.

status: 尚无B19疫苗。
No B19 vaccine is available.
options: 无可供常规接种的预防产品。
No product is available for routine vaccination.
limits: 妊娠、溶血性疾病及免疫低下者的风险管理不能由疫苗替代。
Risk management in pregnancy, hemolytic disorders and immunocompromise cannot rely on vaccination.

status: 尚无常规特异性抗病毒治疗。
No routine specific antiviral treatment is established.
options: 多数感染支持治疗；严重贫血可涉及输血，部分持续感染／再障情境由专科评估静脉免疫球蛋白。
Most infections receive supportive care; severe anemia may require transfusion, and specialists may consider intravenous immunoglobulin in selected persistent-infection/aplastic-anemia settings.
limits: 免疫球蛋白属于被动免疫治疗而非疫苗或直接抗病毒小分子；孕期需评估胎儿贫血。
Immunoglobulin is passive immunotherapy, not a vaccine or direct-acting small molecule; pregnancy may require fetal-anemia assessment.

status: 已有有效甲肝疫苗。
Effective hepatitis A vaccines are available.
options: 国际使用灭活甲肝疫苗；中国亦有减毒活疫苗。
Inactivated HAV vaccines are used internationally; live-attenuated products are also available in China.
limits: 产品年龄适应证和接种政策不同；暴露后预防应按当地指南及时评估。
Age indications and policies differ; post-exposure prevention requires timely assessment under local guidance.

status: 无特异性甲肝抗病毒治疗。
There is no specific antiviral for hepatitis A.
options: 以补液、营养支持和肝功能监测为主，急性肝衰竭需住院治疗。
Management emphasizes hydration, nutrition and liver monitoring; acute liver failure requires hospital care.
limits: 避免把乙肝／丙肝抗病毒药直接用于甲肝，恢复可能需数周至数月。
HBV/HCV antivirals should not be assumed effective for HAV; recovery can take weeks to months.

status: 已有重组乙肝预防疫苗。
Recombinant preventive hepatitis B vaccines are available.
options: 常规婴儿免疫与出生剂次是防控核心，符合条件的未免疫人群亦可接种。
Infant immunization and the birth dose are central to prevention; eligible unvaccinated groups can also receive vaccination.
limits: 疫苗不能治疗已存在的慢性乙肝；围产期预防可能还需母婴专门干预。
Vaccines do not treat established chronic HBV; perinatal prevention may require additional maternal–infant interventions.

status: 慢性乙肝有抑制性抗病毒治疗。
Suppressive antivirals are available for chronic hepatitis B.
options: 替诺福韦或恩替卡韦是重要口服药物，可减少肝硬化进展及肝癌风险。
Tenofovir and entecavir are major oral agents that reduce progression and liver-cancer risk.
limits: 治疗常需长期持续，病毒抑制不等于功能性或彻底治愈；仍需适当肝癌监测。
Treatment is often long term; suppression is not functional or sterilizing cure, and appropriate cancer surveillance remains necessary.

status: 目前无有效丙肝疫苗。
No effective hepatitis C vaccine is currently available.
options: 预防依赖安全注射、血液筛查及减少血液暴露。
Prevention relies on safe injections, blood screening and reducing blood exposure.
limits: 治愈后仍可再次感染，既往感染或治疗不构成疫苗式保护。
Reinfection remains possible after cure; prior infection or treatment does not provide vaccine-like protection.

status: 直接作用抗病毒药可治愈大多数感染者。
Direct-acting antivirals can cure most people with HCV.
options: 泛基因型DAA联合方案是主要治疗方式；WHO列举索磷布韦／达卡他韦等方案。
Pangenotypic DAA combinations are central; WHO lists regimens such as sofosbuvir/daclatasvir.
limits: 须评估肝硬化、既往治疗、合并感染及药物相互作用；治愈并不立即消除既有肝硬化风险。
Cirrhosis, prior therapy, coinfection and interactions affect selection; cure does not immediately erase established cirrhosis-related risk.

status: 没有独立HDV疫苗；乙肝疫苗可间接预防。
There is no separate HDV vaccine; HBV vaccination provides indirect prevention.
options: 通过预防HBV感染来防止HDV共同感染。
Preventing HBV prevents HDV coinfection.
limits: 已患慢性乙肝者接种乙肝疫苗不能可靠预防HDV重叠感染。
HBV vaccination does not reliably prevent HDV superinfection in someone already chronically infected with HBV.

status: 慢性丁肝治疗需专科及地区适应证评估。
Chronic HDV treatment requires specialist and jurisdiction-specific assessment.
options: 聚乙二醇干扰素α用于选定病例；布来韦肽Hepcludex在欧盟获批用于符合条件的代偿性肝病患者。
Pegylated interferon alfa is used in selected cases; bulevirtide (Hepcludex) is EU-authorized for eligible patients with compensated liver disease.
limits: HBV核苷（酸）类似物并不直接有效抑制HDV；病毒学改善不等于已证明所有长期终点获益。
HBV nucleos(t)ide analogues do not directly suppress HDV effectively; virological improvement does not establish benefit for every long-term endpoint.
